title: Return recipient-private operation evidence through Audit Window
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. At R4 let current Shift Lead scan one active player most recent operation and privately learn safe/corrupted/neutral/timeout. Compare that player own selected axis to its incident safe/corrupt option; timeout provenance takes the timeout label without claiming alignment. D-AUDIT-NO-HISTORY must specify behavior for a target who has never operated. Return no other player private input, exact diagnostic or role, and do not broadcast the result. Consume the granted Audit opportunity once and emit the semantic board marker.
acceptance: Safe/corrupted/neutral/timeout fixtures report the target most recent operation only to the authorized Lead.
Unknown/inactive targets, wrong actor/phase/revision and duplicate use are rejected without leaking private history.
A no-history target follows the approved D-AUDIT-NO-HISTORY decision instead of inventing a fifth outcome.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
